projects.title: Bakery Shop Management System
projects.description: A C# WinForms and SQL Server based management system for products, inventory, sales, orders, invoices and user roles.
projects.label: C# / SQL
projects.overview: A desktop bakery management application built with C# WinForms and SQL Server to manage products, inventory, sales, orders, invoices and user roles in one system.
projects.problem: Manual product, stock and sales handling can make inventory updates, order processing and reporting difficult to manage consistently.
projects.solution: The system brings product management, inventory, cashier sales, order details, invoice generation and role-based access into a single application connected to SQL Server.

projects.title: E-Commerce Sales Forecasting
projects.description: An academic data science project combining e-commerce sales analysis, machine learning forecasting and interactive visualization.
projects.label: ML / DATA
projects.overview: An academic data science project that analyzes e-commerce transactions and compares machine learning approaches for sales forecasting and interactive business visualization.
projects.problem: E-commerce data contains sales, pricing, discount, region and product information that can be difficult to interpret together for forecasting and decision support.
projects.solution: The project prepares and analyzes sales data, builds machine learning models such as Random Forest and XGBoost, evaluates their performance and presents findings through interactive visualizations.

projects.title: Interactive E-Commerce Sales Analytics
projects.description: Analysis of sales trends, customers, regions, products, profit/loss and business factors using data visualization techniques.
projects.label: ANALYTICS
projects.overview: An interactive e-commerce analytics project focused on understanding sales performance, customer behavior, products, regions, discounts and profit/loss patterns.
projects.problem: Raw transaction records make it difficult to identify trends and business factors without structured analysis and visualization.
projects.solution: The project transforms transaction data into visual analyses covering monthly sales, regional performance, product behavior, customer patterns and profit/loss.

projects.title: Machine Learning Experiments
projects.description: Practical experimentation with regression, ensemble learning, model evaluation and clustering techniques for academic work.
projects.label: MACHINE LEARNING
projects.overview: A collection of academic machine learning experiments covering regression, ensemble learning, model evaluation and clustering techniques.
projects.problem: Different datasets and prediction tasks require different modelling approaches and evaluation methods.
projects.solution: The experiments implement multiple machine learning techniques and compare their behavior using appropriate evaluation measures and exploratory analysis.

research.title: Educational Aspirations and Brain Drain: A Study of Bangladeshi Undergraduate Students' Perspectives
research.description: A student survey-based research project exploring factors that influence undergraduate students' aspirations to study or build careers abroad. The work examines educational, career and personal considerations reported by respondents.
research.abstract: A student survey-based research project exploring factors that influence undergraduate students' aspirations to study or build careers abroad. The work examines educational, career and personal considerations reported by respondents.
research.problem: The study examines the factors that influence Bangladeshi undergraduate students’ aspirations to study or build careers abroad.
research.gap: Student-focused evidence is needed to better understand the educational, career and personal factors associated with overseas study and career aspirations.
research.methodology: Questionnaire-based survey collection, response organization and descriptive analysis of reported educational, career and personal considerations.
research.results: The reported findings and respondent perspectives are documented in the research report.

research.title: E-Commerce Sales Forecasting Using Machine Learning and Interactive Visualization
research.description: Research work focused on e-commerce sales analysis, forecasting and interactive visualization. The study prepares sales data, analyzes product/customer/region/profit patterns and compares machine learning approaches such as Random Forest and XGBoost using evaluation metrics.
research.method: Data analysis + machine learning + interactive visualization
research.dataset: Research dataset — 5,000 sampled e-commerce transaction records
research.abstract: Research work focused on e-commerce sales analysis, forecasting and interactive visualization. The study prepares sales data, analyzes product/customer/region/profit patterns and compares machine learning approaches such as Random Forest and XGBoost using evaluation metrics.
research.problem: How can e-commerce transaction data be analyzed and machine learning models be used for sales forecasting while presenting the results through interactive visualization?
research.gap: Existing dashboard-oriented work does not fully combine machine learning model comparison, factor analysis and a unified product, customer, region and profit visualization workflow.
research.methodology: Data cleaning and preparation, exploratory sales analysis, feature preparation, Random Forest and XGBoost model development, model evaluation and interactive visualization of business insights.
research.results: The study compares machine learning approaches using forecasting evaluation metrics and presents sales, product, customer, region and profit/loss insights.

about.heading: Building skills through learning & projects.
paragraphs: I am Md Sobahan Hasan Saikat, a Computer Science & Engineering student at American International University-Bangladesh (AIUB).

I am interested in data analytics, programming, machine learning, software development and database systems. I enjoy turning ideas into practical solutions and continuously improving my technical skills through academic and personal projects.

I also have professional exposure to graphics and content design and digital marketing. I treat these as supporting skills that complement my technology background rather than as my primary career focus.
